import cv2, numpy as np, json, math
from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter1d
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
from rcb_brush import WangBrush, BRUSH_WANG, CalligraphyPainter, sheets_from_inst, Wells
from PIL import Image
PX=0.22185986964255727
mask=(np.asarray(Image.open('/app/target.png'))[:,:,0]<100).astype(np.uint8)
n,labels,stats,cents=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(mask)

def resample(p,spacing=.25,closed=False):
 p=np.asarray(p,float)
 if closed: p=np.vstack([p,p[0]])
 ds=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p,axis=0),axis=1); good=np.r_[True,ds>1e-7];p=p[good]
 if len(p)<2:return p
 t=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p,axis=0),axis=1))]
 tt=np.linspace(0,t[-1],max(2,int(np.ceil(t[-1]/spacing))+1))
 return np.column_stack([np.interp(tt,t,p[:,i]) for i in range(p.shape[1])])[:-1] if closed else np.column_stack([np.interp(tt,t,p[:,i]) for i in range(p.shape[1])])

def getloops(component, width=1.5, first=.72, step=1.05):
 d=cv2.distanceTransform((labels==component).astype(np.uint8),cv2.DIST_L2,5)*PX
 nodes=[]; prev=[]
 for level in np.arange(first,float(d.max()),step):
  contours,_=cv2.findContours((d>=level).astype(np.uint8),cv2.RETR_LIST,cv2.CHAIN_APPROX_NONE)
  current=[]
  for c in contours:
   if len(c)<4:continue
   p=(c[:,0,:].astype(float)+.5)*PX
   p=resample(p,.22,True)
   if len(p)<5:continue
   p=gaussian_filter1d(p,1.3,axis=0,mode='wrap')
   node={'p':p,'children':[], 'level':level}
   if prev:
    best=None
    for par in prev:
     dd,ii=cKDTree(par['p']).query(p)
     j=int(dd.argmin()); candidate=(float(dd[j]),int(ii[j]),j,par)
     if best is None or candidate[0]<best[0]: best=candidate
    node['entry']=best[2];best[3]['children'].append((best[1],node))
   else: node['entry']=0
   current.append(node);nodes.append(node)
  if not current:break
  prev=current
 roots=[x for x in nodes if abs(x['level']-first)<1e-5]
 return roots

def traverse(node):
 p=node['p'];e=node['entry']; childmap={}
 for i,c in node['children']:childmap.setdefault(i,[]).append(c)
 out=[]
 for k in range(len(p)+1):
  i=(e+k)%len(p);out.append(p[i])
  if k<len(p):
   for c in childmap.get(i,[]):
    cp=traverse(c);out.extend(cp);out.append(p[i])
 return np.array(out)

def plan_component(component,width=1.5,first=.72,step=1.05):
 roots=getloops(component,width,first,step)
 assert len(roots)==1, len(roots)
 p=traverse(roots[0]);p=resample(p,.15)
 # smooth root motion, in particular the bridges between nested loops.
 p=gaussian_filter1d(p,1.5,axis=0,mode='nearest')
 z=(width+.3)/1.187
 wb=WangBrush(BRUSH_WANG); O=wb.offset_of(z/1000)*1000
 tangent=np.gradient(p,axis=0);tangent/=np.maximum(1e-6,np.linalg.norm(tangent,axis=1))[:,None]
 handle=p+O*tangent
 return p,handle,z

if __name__=='__main__':

"""Generate a deterministic three-contact brush copy of the supplied exemplar."""
import os, time, json, argparse
os.environ.setdefault('OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS','1')
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from rcb_brush import Session
from plan import plan_component,resample,PX,mask

def generate(args):
 s=Session(instance='/app/instance.json',render=False);p=s.primitives();s.record_start();t=time.time()
 p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.065],speed=.10,settle=5)
 p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.025],speed=.04,settle=8)
 p['move_tip']([-.1,.15,.06],speed=.06,settle=4)
 def world(h,z):
  x,y=s.geo.mm_to_world(*h);return np.array([x,y,z])
 for c in args.components:
  roots,handle,press=plan_component(c,args.width,args.first,args.spacing)
  # Keep commands smooth enough for the joint PD controller.
  hh=resample(handle,args.speed*1000/20)
  p['move_tip'](world(hh[0],.045),speed=.09,settle=5)
  p['move_tip'](world(hh[0],.02-press/1000),speed=.012,settle=8)
  prevq=s.hold_action().astype(float)
  for i,h in enumerate(hh):
   q,ok,err=s.ik(world(h,.02-press/1000),q_init=prevq)
   if not ok:raise RuntimeError(('ik',c,i,err))
   command=q+args.ff*(q-prevq)
   s.step(command);prevq=q
   if i%500==0:print('component',c,'point',i,'/',len(hh),'steps',s.n_steps,'wall',round(time.time()-t,1),flush=True)
  for _ in range(8):s.step(prevq)
  p['move_tip'](world(hh[-1],.045),speed=.015,settle=8)
  Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save(f'/app/output/canvas_{c}.png')
  print('finished',c,s.n_steps,flush=True)
 p['hold'](10)
 actions=s.record_stop();s.save_trajectory(actions,args.out)
 ink=s.ink();np.save('/app/output/ink.npy',ink)
 Image.fromarray(s.canvas()).save('/app/output/canvas.png')
 a=ink>=.5;b=mask>0
 print('LOCAL',dict(iou=float((a&b).sum()/(a|b).sum()),recall=float((a&b).sum()/b.sum()),precision=float((a&b).sum()/a.sum())),flush=True)
 print('SAVED',args.out,'actions',len(actions),'sha',s.state_sha(),'wall',time.time()-t,flush=True)
 if args.score:
  score=s.score();print('SCORE',json.dumps(score),flush=True);json.dump(score,open('/app/output/score.json','w'),indent=2)

if __name__=='__main__':
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('--components',nargs='+',type=int,default=[3,2,1]);ap.add_argument('--width',type=float,default=1.5);ap.add_argument('--first',type=float,default=.72);ap.add_argument('--spacing',type=float,default=1.05);ap.add_argument('--speed',type=float,default=.012);ap.add_argument('--ff',type=float,default=1.6);ap.add_argument('--out',default='/app/output/trajectory.npz');ap.add_argument('--score',action='store_true');args=ap.parse_args();generate(args)
